Tour itinerary

  1. Stop 1Transfer from Kandy toward Rangala or Thangappuwa

    Leave Kandy for the Knuckles foothills and confirm the trailhead with your guide.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  2. Stop 2Guided Kotaganga waterfall hike

    Follow the guided route towards the Kotaganga cascades. Water levels can affect access.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  3. Stop 3Return to Kandy

    Return to Kandy after the walk.
